best2.formula: v = best + F * (r1 - r2) + F * (r3 - r4)
best2.role: 最优引导的双差分探索

current_to_best1.formula: v = x + F * (best - x) + F * (r1 - r2)
current_to_best1.role: 当前个体向最优解收缩并保留差分探索

current_to_rand1.role: 当前个体向随机参考点移动

current_to_pbest1.formula: v = x + F * (pbest - x) + F * (r1 - r2)
current_to_pbest1.role: 随机精英参考的自适应开发/探索平衡

opposition1.role: 最优点对立方向的破局探索

history_guided1.formula: v = x + F * (history - x) + F * (r1 - r2)
history_guided1.role: 历史参考的定向迁移和差分扰动
